desc: Fix file naming: rename feature_toggle.js and standardize utils naming
context: Two naming issues (evidence: naming-01, naming-02): (1) ui/src/app/feature_toggle.js must be renamed to ui/src/app/_feature_toggle.js to match the _ prefix convention. Find all imports of feature_toggle and update them. (2) ui/src/app/utils/: promptDownloadUtils.js, rulesDownloadUtils.js, tokenUtils.js use camelCase instead of _ prefix. Rename to _prompt_download_utils.js, _rules_download_utils.js, _token_utils.js. Update all imports. Grep for each filename before renaming to find all import references.
acceptance_criteria: No import references to the old filenames remain
